measurements.description: Readings attached to this alert episode, oldest first.
measurements.title: Measurements

confirmed.description: PULSE cannot verify that a call or share happened.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

age.description: Approximate age in years (current year - birth_year, may be 1 year high). Null when the patient has not entered a birth year, or before migration M5 (patient_profiles.birth_year) is applied.
age.title: Age

client_fallback.description: Used by the frontend ONLY when the API cannot be reached.

id.description: Generated by the client so retries are idempotent.
id.title: Id

number.description: Null = not configured (demo mode without PULSE_DEMO_NUMBER, dev only): disable the call button and show a configuration warning.
number.title: Number

verified.description: False until the team has confirmed the number (decision D3).
verified.title: Verified

readings.description: Readings from started_at - 24 h to started_at + 24 h.
readings.title: Readings

EvaluationOut.description:
Deterministic rule result, always returned in the same response as the reading or symptom report.

Reading flagged invalid by the database: level="none", rule_id="DATA-INVALID", no alert, next_step asks
to measure again; if the reading is above the plausibility limits (systolic > 300 or diastolic > 200)
requires_symptom_check is true so a typo never hides a possible crisis.

level.description: none | notice (above target) | trend | severe (>= 180 or >= 120) | emergency (red-flag symptom).
level.title: Level

recheck_after_seconds.description: If set and no red-flag symptom: show a timer, then ask for a new reading.
recheck_after_seconds.title: Recheck After Seconds

requires_symptom_check.description: Show the symptom checklist now and POST symptom-reports.
requires_symptom_check.title: Requires Symptom Check

rule_id.description: Rule that decided the level: R-EMG-1, R-SEV-1/2/3, R-TGT-1, R-TRD-1, or DATA-INVALID.
rule_id.title: Rule Id

EvaluationOut.title: EvaluationOut

source.description: Show 'simulated' readings as simulated, never as a real measurement.
source.title: Source

MeasurementIn.description:
Bounds below are the database storage limits only (CHECK constraints), so impossible input gets
one consistent 422. Plausibility (e.g. systolic > 300 = invalid) is decided by the database policy
pulse-v1 after the reading is stored, and reported in measurement.validation_status.

measured_at.description: Defaults to server time when omitted.
measured_at.title: Measured At

measured_tz.description: IANA zone where the reading was taken; defaults to the profile time zone.
measured_tz.title: Measured Tz

MeasurementIn.title: MeasurementIn

validation_status.description: Computed by the database (policy pulse-v1); never sent by clients.
validation_status.title: Validation Status

alert.description: Alert created, attached to, or raised by this reading.

note.description: Private clinical note; null when the reader is the patient.
note.title: Note

age.description: Approximate age in years (current year - birth_year, may be 1 year high). Null when the patient has not entered a birth year, or before migration M5 (patient_profiles.birth_year) is applied.
age.title: Age

PredictionOut.description:
Latest row of ml_predictions for the configured model version, written by the offline batch job.
model_unavailable: no row, or the newest row targets a day before the patient's local today (stale).

limitations.default: Experimental model estimate trained on synthetic data only. Not a measurement, not clinically validated, never used for alerts or emergency guidance.
limitations.title: Limitations

PredictionOut.title: PredictionOut

ProfileIn.description:
PUT replaces the whole profile: every field is required (send null or [] to clear a value), so a
partial form can never silently erase allergies, conditions or location consent.

birth_year.description: Year only (data minimisation). Stored by migration M5; the API also rejects years after the current year.
birth_year.title: Birth Year

medication_context.description: As entered by the patient; PULSE never interprets it.
medication_context.title: Medication Context

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn

measurement_id.description: The reading that led to this check. Must be one of the patient's readings (else 422); not stored until migration M7 adds the column.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

measurement_id.description: Always null until migration M7 stores the link.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

report.description: Always stored, including an empty 'none of these' answer (migration M3, live).

note.description: Required to resolve a severe or emergency alert.
note.title: Note

contact_consented.description: The patient confirms the contact agreed to be listed.
contact_consented.title: Contact Consented

TrustedContactPatch.description:
A different phone number may be a different person who never consented: changing `phone` is refused
(422 consent_required); delete the contact and add the new number with contact_consented=true.
TrustedContactPatch.title: TrustedContactPatch

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to display times, e.g. Africa/Algiers.
timezone.title: Timezone

HTTPBearer.description: Supabase Auth access token from POST /auth/login.

info.description: Hypertension monitoring prototype. Not a medical device.
